title: Explorer
summary: Confronting the gap between intent and AI output. Learning where judgment begins.
primaryRisk: Treating fluent synthetic prose as finished thinking—leading to endless prompt-tweaking.
humanCheckpoint: Problem Framing & Premise Lock before touching a model.

title: Practitioner
summary: From prompts to workflows. Building repeatable systems instead of isolated outputs.
primaryRisk: Hero-prompting in private chat threads that cannot be audited or reproduced.

title: Integrator
summary: Human-in-the-loop design. Defining where human oversight is required to maintain strategic rigor and ethical compliance.
primaryRisk: Automation complacency (rubber-stamping AI output) or bottlenecking every minor step.
humanCheckpoint: High-Consequence Decision Gates on evidentiary claims and policy trade-offs.

title: Architect
summary: From using systems to designing them. Creating agentic infrastructures that operate with defined boundaries.
primaryRisk: Unbounded agent loops amplifying upstream assumptions and strategic noise.

title: Steward
summary: The final shift: taste. Learning to govern outcomes, not interfaces.
primaryRisk: Strategic homogenization—sounding and deciding identically to every competitor.
humanCheckpoint: Editorial Taste & Outcome Audits against institutional positioning.
